rationale: All 3 blocking findings resolved in fix-up commit 99faa4582. CR-001: invalid_tool_calls truncation now finalizes then raises via _safe_check_for_truncation (new test). CR-002: forwarding limited to Claude models per the human's scope decision (2 new tests + log test). CR-003: supervisor WARNING content asserted. The fix-up diff introduces no new high-risk issue. Round 2 (alias scope added by the product owner after code-review.check): d24b61650 detects Claude behind an alias via LLMModel.claude_family; a blind and an edge-case lens reviewed it and raised CR-004 (Bedrock application-inference-profile ARN not detected) and CR-005 (no end-to-end mapper->factory test), both fixed in 562eb0ca0. 3 dismissed: serialization round-trip dropping the flag (no dump-and-rebuild path exists; model_copy keeps it), a non-Claude deployment named 'claude' (unrealistic), no clamp on large values (intended, spec §3.1/§4). Round 3 (CI SonarQube quality gate on MR !4519: 1 new critical issue): 0145543ae moves Claude detection into _is_claude_family (provider check via LLMProvider.ANTHROPIC.value) and names the 'max_tokens' request key _MAX_TOKENS_PARAM, clearing the two python:S1192 literal duplicates the branch added ('anthropic' x3 in models.py, 'max_tokens' x3 in llm_factory.py) and returning map_litellm_to_llm_model to its main-branch complexity. An independent blind/edge-case review found it behaviour-equivalent for all inputs; 1 minor deferred (parse_update_type cognitive complexity ~14, under the S3776 limit of 15). Ruff clean; 943 targeted tests passed.
